basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old data analyst based in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for understanding the complexities of the human mind. I was diagnosed with ADHD in my late teens, which sparked my interest in neurodiversity. When I'm not crunching numbers or diving deep into neuroscience literature, I enjoy hiking in the beautiful Pacific Northwest and experimenting with new technology and apps that make life a bit easier. I'm usually online in the evenings, often after putting my two kids to bed. Happily married for over a decade, I often seek and offer advice on balancing work and family life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in Data Science and have worked in the tech industry for over 12 years. My knowledge of ADHD and neurodiversity is largely self-taught, fueled by personal experiences and extensive reading of both scientific articles and community discussions online.
